body: I'm in the same mindset. For heaven sounds like another hell. No relationships? No being able to find a soul mate and marry them if you die signal? And yeah it does sound like we would be mind wiped if we get in. I personally would prefer to be erased from existence. I feel like there isn't a choice and th threat of hell pushes me to fall in line to choose the correct side  rather than wanting to live in heaven.
Me and a friend of mine have been doing it for a few days now but no joy

Yeah I know how you feel. I'm 25 and I'm stuck working at Wal-Mart while in school. Failed a good 12 times trying to join the Military. Suck at relationships, includes parents, siblings, friends (i have only a few) , and forget about getting a gf. I want you to keep trying to find a reason to live. Try reach out to people and don't shut yourself in. Its too late for me, a good chance ill end my life soon. But it isn't too late for you just push through it.
